patch.summary: Bright Data implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Bright Data by mapping current it-development workflows to Bright Data objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Python, Nodejs, Scrapy) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Python

blocks.heading: Bright Data day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Bright Data setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Data engineering teams needing reliable residential/datacenter proxy networks before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Python and Nodejs before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence
Do not expand seats until CI/CD and automation is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Compliance and acceptable-use rules must be validated per project

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, source control, or hosting panel

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Starter ~list price floor is expensive for casual scraping experiments

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Bright Data plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Pay-as-you-go
lines.description: Contact sales · Unlocks: CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network, developer AI assistance · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

lines.label: Starter commitment
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate it-development fit before a deep Bright Data rollout
blocks.body: If Bright Data fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Bright Data object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on CI/CD and automation
If blocked, evaluate Oxylabs before sunk-cost expansion
